reports.rendered_content: The UI renders a Field for 'Multi-origin blend' with a Select that conditionally appears when dualAvailable is true. When blendMode is not 'primary_only', it shows a 'Secondary panorama' Select with auto-option and candidate list, plus an amber warning if dualReady is false. If eligible.length===0, a graybox hint appears. A 'Geometry occlusion' Toggle (default true) controls whether surfaces hidden behind geometry are excluded.
